verdict.rationale: Plymouth Street is an immigration-services firm with a client-facing web presence and status dashboards, so a privacy control like opting out of usage tracking is a fair question to ask. However, the evidence pack contains nothing about telemetry, analytics, cookies or any opt-out mechanism. The 'Protected data security' claim is an adjacent control, not a tracking opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
